Nina: Quick async standup - short notes (W / B / T)
Nina: W: deployed batcher memory cap tweak to eu-west, verified warmups. p50 embeddings improved ~5%
Nina: B: intermittent 503s from dedicated pool during short queue spikes; need deeper trace
Nina: T: pull dispatcher traces, open draft PR for backpressure and cooldown tuning

Raj: I saw the same 503 cluster at 04:12 UTC, aligns with autoscaler cooldown flapping
Raj: Temporarily bumped cooldown to 3m for the affected pool; monitoring now
Raj: Q: permanent policy change or per-pool adaptive cooldown?

Alex: Prefer adaptive per-policy cooldowns, not global. Longer global cooldowns hide other issues
Alex: Can you share a dispatcher trace id and a small log excerpt? I can grep kernel logs

Nina: trace id: trace-e7a1b2f
Nina: dispatcher snippet: ```ERROR dispatcher: kv cache miss -> fallback handler exceeded 300ms```

Pat: oncall-bot: incident created INC-7112 - 503-spike-eu-west (severity: low)
oncall-bot: https://redwood.incidents/INC-7112

Tess: Tuned embedding-queue alert: 60s rolling, threshold -> 1400 tokens. Runbook link is stale
Tess: Filed follow-up to refresh synthetic checks and runbook mapping (SRE-1499)

Nina: runbook -> https://docs.redwood/runbooks/batcher-evict (I'll update the alert metadata in the PR)

Raj: CR ping @Alex @Tess - https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/891 (dispatcher: backpressure + cooldown strategy)
Raj: Added integration harness, still iterating on cooldown unit test

Alex: Reviewed initial patch; comment about metric labels (use pool_id). Also add a fast scale-down integration test

Tess: Noted an alert storm earlier from a noisy synthetic - muted briefly and filed SRE-1498 for cleanup

Pat: Handoff: Mike on pager from 21:00 UTC. Notes: watch autoscaler logs, embedding queue, warmup-run success rate

Mike: I'll run a full warmup sequence on eu-west at 20:30. If I hit >3 503 spikes in 15m will escalate
Mike: Quick Q: do we have canary steps for cooldown policy?

Alex: Canary checklist: 1) single pool canary, 2) enable debug metrics, 3) 1h observation, 4) rollback script ready

Nina: adding checklist and short how-to to the PR description. If patch lands, I'll update runbook and alert meta tonight

Raj: perf tip: enable a 1% batcher debug sampler to capture KV sizes: `BATCHER_DEBUG_SAMPLER=0.01`

Alex: good call - helps correlate request shape with queue pressure

oncall-bot: incident INC-7112 status -> monitoring

Pat: Plan: if no regressions by 23:30 UTC we promote patch to canary-2. Closing loop, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
